title: MARA prices $185M debt offering after $1.1B Bitcoin sale
summary: The Bitcoin miner is taking on new debt to finance its AI infrastructure expansion, with the Long Ridge acquisition adding nearly $69 million in annual interest costs.
author: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

title: Zelle picks Solana for ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments
summary: Zelle plans to use Solana for its ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments, with confidential transfers designed to hide payment amounts.
author: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

title: Securitize agrees to buy River One to expand into asset-backed lending
summary: Securitize agreed to buy River One to bring stablecoin funding to asset-backed lending and expects the deal to close in the fourth quarter of 2026.
author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

title: Binance to shut down crypto mining pool services in November
summary: Binance will discontinue its mining pool and related services on Nov. 10, urging miners to move to alternative pools before the shutdown.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: Porsche’s ‘long haul’ Web3 project ends in less than four years
summary: Porsche is winding down its Web3 project and Pioneers Circle community as trading activity in its 911 NFT collection falls sharply from early levels.
author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

title: CoinMarketCap buys CoinGlass to expand crypto derivatives data
summary: CoinGlass will retain its brand and team, while its website, app, free tools, API and pricing will remain unchanged following the acquisition.
author: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

title: MoonPay to buy North Capital in all-stock deal worth over $60M
summary: MoonPay’s North Capital acquisition adds US broker-dealer, trading and investment infrastructure as it expands into tokenized securities.
author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

title: BitMart misses roadmap deadline, appoints financial adviser
summary: BitMart provided no asset figures or withdrawal timetable and will launch a feedback portal within five working days during a financial adviser review.
author: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

title: Circle to acquire Tazapay to expand USDC cross-border payments
summary: Tazapay processes $25 billion in annualized volume and offers payout rails across 100-plus markets, extending Circle’s USDC payments reach.
author: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

title: BitGo buys NYDIG trading arm to deepen institutional crypto push
summary: BitGo completed its acquisition of NYDIG’s institutional trading business, adding about 30 employees and expanding its derivatives and financing capabilities.
author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
